description: Repairs r-expr-1/pat-11-16-counted-nul-and-reuse: the worker crashed in Requery(qd). Asks the same counted-NUL question over Pn (A, A+NUL, A+NUL+B, A+NUL+C): Len, '=', LIKE A*, A? and A??; a WHERE with a NUL literal; an undeclared [pp] set in turn to A+NUL+B, A+NUL+C, A+NUL+B, A+NUL+* and A; then a dynaset opened with pp = A+NUL+B, pp changed to A+NUL+C, Requery() with no argument, and read again. Fixture r-fix-expr-sql-expr is opened read-only through DAO.DBEngine.120; each recordset reads Name, Type and Value of every field. Each statement is preceded by a marker (a DROP TABLE of a table that does not exist, which always fails), so DBEngine.Errors read after the statement shows that statement's own failure or the marker's, never an older one. Where Field Precision and Scale are read, the recordset is first positioned on its first row (MoveFirst) and DecimalPlaces is not read.
retentionNote: Designed r-fix-expr-sql probe (A-02); complete capture of the ACE answer.
